purpose: Employee views their own EIS profile successfully
preconditions: Employee is authenticated and has an existing EmployeeProfile
expected_result: HTTP 200 with full profile data (pf_number, designation, department, date_of_joining, experiences)

purpose: Employee views their profile but no profile exists yet
preconditions: Employee is authenticated but has no EmployeeProfile
expected_result: HTTP 404 with message 'Profile not found for logged in user.'

purpose: Unauthenticated user tries to view employee profile
Employee adds a new work experience entry
preconditions: Employee is authenticated and has an EmployeeProfile
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/hr-eis/experiences/ with valid organization, position, start_date
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created; new experience returned with correct fields

purpose: Employee submits work experience with invalid date range (end before start)
preconditions: Employee is authenticated and has an EmployeeProfile
expected_result: HTTP 400 with validation error on end_date field

purpose: Employee adds ongoing work experience (no end date)
preconditions: Employee is authenticated and has an EmployeeProfile
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created; end_date is null in response

purpose: Staff user retrieves all employee profiles
preconditions: Staff user is authenticated; multiple EmployeeProfiles exist

purpose: Non-staff employee retrieves profiles and only sees their own
preconditions: Non-staff user authenticated; multiple profiles exist
expected_result: HTTP 200 returning only the requesting employee's profile

purpose: Employee retrieves their list of work experiences
preconditions: Employee authenticated; has existing WorkExperience entries
expected_result: HTTP 200 returning only the employee's own experiences

purpose: Employee retrieves work experiences but has none yet
preconditions: Employee authenticated; no WorkExperience exists for the employee

purpose: Employee deletes a work experience entry
preconditions: Employee authenticated; a WorkExperience exists belonging to this employee
expected_result: HTTP 204 No Content; record no longer appears in GET list
